bib.title: TaskMatrix.AI: Completing Tasks by Connecting Foundation Models with Millions of APIs

read.skipped: References skimmed only; no appendices exist

question: How can foundation models be connected to millions of existing model and system APIs so they complete digital and physical tasks?
hypothesis: A foundation model that plans a solution outline, selects APIs documented in a unified schema and emits action code can complete diverse tasks and improve through feedback.
contributions: Architecture of four components: multimodal conversational foundation model, API platform, API selector, action executor
Unified five-part API documentation schema, with composition instructions
Learning loops: RLHF for the model and selector, and feedback to API developers that treats API documentation as learnable parameters
Qualitative case studies in visual tasks, long content, office automation, cloud services and robotics/IoT, with a PowerPoint implementation

results.claim: A single complex PowerPoint instruction (a slide per company) decomposes into about 25 API calls.
results.setup: PowerPoint case study, ChatGPT as MCFM, python-pptx and PyAutoGUI APIs, one demonstration dialogue
results.quote: the third query requires 25 APIs to complete
results.note: Section 4.2 says 'roughly 25 API calls'; anecdotal, not an evaluation

results.claim: Removing composition instructions made the model emit calls in a wrong order (insert before select) and long unbroken paragraphs; with them it always selected the text box first.
results.setup: PowerPoint slide generation, ChatGPT, composition instructions on insert_text, select_title, select_content; qualitative, no counts or trials given
results.quote: including the composition instructions for select_title and select_content ensures that MCFM always selects the target text box before inserting the text

results.claim: ChatGPT can turn <instruction, wrong calls, correct calls> into documentation feedback; the first two of five items matched the hand-written composition instructions.
results.setup: One example, ChatGPT, API docs without composition instructions
results.quote: we found that the first two items of feedback were highly related to our composition instructions
results.note: Source text uses a fi ligature in 'first'; quote is claim-level only

results.claim: A text-only MCFM (ChatGPT) handled image tasks by calling visual model APIs, with no retraining.
No quantitative evaluation is reported: all scenarios are illustrative dialogues.

limits: Position paper: no benchmark, success rate, baseline or ablation numbers; all evidence is single demonstration dialogues
Claims all cases are implemented and an online system will be released soon, but no code or system is given
API selector and RLHF are described but not implemented or evaluated (Sec 4 skips selector, postpones RLHF for lack of user feedback)
Authors concede open challenges: multimodal MCFM, API documentation quality and assurance, API selection among millions, online planning, security and privacy, personalization
Ordering from composition instructions is shown on one task, with the authors noting the model sometimes got it right without them
Dated: relies on ChatGPT/GPT-4 of early 2023 and the doc-only API approach later became standard function calling

terms.definition: Multimodal Conversational Foundation Model, responsible for communicating with users, understanding goals and contexts, and generating executable code based on APIs
a textual description of the steps needed to solve the task
optional API doc field guiding the model on how to combine multiple APIs to accomplish complex user instructions
